description: This file defines mock classes for IWebAudioPlayer and IWebAudioPlayerFactory interfaces used in testing WebAudioPlayer components within the Rialto project. It includes mock method declarations for simulating WebAudioPlayer behavior in unit tests.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for IWebAudioPlayerFactory interface, used to create mock WebAudioPlayer instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerMock
classes.description: Mock class for IWebAudioPlayer interface, providing mock implementations for WebAudioPlayer methods.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a mock WebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and config.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Simulates starting playback of the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Simulates pausing playback of the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end-of-stream state for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes data to the WebAudioPlayer buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with the WebAudioPlayer.
